This document imports the raw Mowtivation plot-level dataset, checks its
structure, applies documented data preparation steps, and saves the processed
dataset used by the outcome-specific analyses.

# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
```

# Packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(here)
```

# File paths

```{r paths}
raw_file <- here(
  "data", "raw", "All Treatments", "combined_raw.xlsx"
)

processed_dir <- here("data", "processed")

stopifnot(file.exists(raw_file))
```

# Import raw data

```{r import-raw-data}
raw_data <- read_excel(raw_file) |>
  clean_names()

glimpse(raw_data)
```

# Initial data checks

## Site-year structure

```{r site-year-checks}
raw_data |>
  count(location, year)

raw_data |>
  count(location, year, treatment)
```

## Identifier checks

```{r identifier-checks}
raw_data |>
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_unique_ids = n_distinct(id),
    n_unique_plot_records = n_distinct(location, year, block, plot),
    duplicate_ids = sum(duplicated(id)),
    duplicate_plot_records = sum(
      duplicated(paste(location, year, block, plot, sep = "_"))
    )
  )
```

## Missing values

```{r missing-values}
raw_data |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) |>
  filter(n_missing > 0)
```

# Prepare analysis dataset

The conversions will be added here after the source units for each response
variable have been confirmed. The raw values will remain unchanged.

```{r prepare-data}
processed_data <- raw_data |>
  mutate(
    cereal_rye_variety = recode(
      cereal_rye_variety,
      "aroostook" = "Aroostook",
      "nd gardner" = "ND Gardner"
    ),
    site_year = paste(location, year, sep = "_"),
    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("RNO", "RIM", "RIC", "TIM", "TIC")
    ),
    location = factor(location, levels = c("V", "O2W", "O2E")),
    year = as.integer(year),
    block = as.factor(block),
    plot = as.integer(plot)
  )
```

# Conversion notes

The following source units still need to be confirmed before the conversion
code is added:

```{r conversion-notes, eval=FALSE}
# bean_emergence
# bean_biomass
# inrow_weed_biomass
# interrow_weed_biomass
# weed_biomass
# inrow_mulch_biomass
# interrow_mulch_biomass
# mulch_biomass
# bean_population
# bean_yield
# seed_weight
```

# Save processed data

After the source units and conversions have been confirmed, the processed
dataset will be saved here:

```{r save-processed-data, eval=FALSE}
dir.create(processed_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

saveRDS(
  processed_data,
  file = file.path(processed_dir, "combined_processed.rds")
)
```
